evals.prompt: A new example was just crawled into examples/021 (see its README for the citation). Make it run to completion in the harness: check whether it needs a twin, and if it does create examples/121 as its local twin with the fewest edits, a LOCAL.md listing every edit, and run it in full mode on Jenkins and act. Report the verdicts and what the twin establishes.
evals.expected_output: examples/121/ with Jenkinsfile (each edit marked j2gha-local), LOCAL.md (edit table, unchanged features, what it tests, expected converted-side outcome, scenario, results), source.json with derived_from, analysis/ and gha/; examples/021/Jenkinsfile untouched; a Jenkins full-mode SUCCESS record under examples/121/runs/jenkins-full and an act record with a verdict; the report names the verdict per tier and any converter gap found.

assertions.text: examples/021/Jenkinsfile is byte-identical to its committed version (the cited file is never edited)
examples/121/Jenkinsfile exists and every line that differs from examples/021/Jenkinsfile carries a j2gha-local marker, or is marked on the line above when it ends in a shell continuation

examples/121/LOCAL.md has an edit table with one row per changed or inserted line, an unchanged-features paragraph, a 'what this twin tests' paragraph, an expected converted-side outcome and the scenario command
examples/121/runs/act-full/result.json exists with a comparison verdict, and LOCAL.md records the Jenkins result and the act verdict
no stage, when gate, parallel/matrix block or post block of the original was deleted in the twin (structure preserved; only command text and literal values changed)
replacement commands create the files that later stash/archive/junit/readFile steps use, rather than those steps being removed or given allowEmpty flags
the final report names the per-tier verdict and states whether a converter gap or a hollow result is involved
a failure before any stage caused by a harness stub (J2ghaAny in the error, an undetected credential, a missing wrapper) is fixed in the harness with a test, not edited around in the twin
